text:
elaine (partnerships): Quick recap from the vendor call — they flagged a nonstandard H100 firmware image that fails our CI certs. This blocks B200/H200 wave if we don't triage before the marketplace cutover.

rob (hw-ops): Ugh. Do we have the firmware id / checksum? Can lab re-flash an H100 to repro?

elaine (partnerships): Vendor provided sha256: 3f2b9a... (ticket #PRT-4921). They say it's intentional for some custom telemetry.

rob (hw-ops): Ok will try to repro in lab today. If it's telemetry-only we can build a signed shim to strip it during certing. ETA 6 hours.

sarah (eng-platform): Heads up — marketplace SKU tagging and the listing pipeline are set to cut tomorrow 14:00 PT. If certs are delayed past T-4h we need to hold the listing. Noted.

kevin (product): If we hold listing, we need to push announcement. What's the press embargo window?

ops-bot: Reminder: marketplace cutover job scheduled for 2027-09-14 14:00 PT. (run id: cutover-9243)

devon (solutions): Short-term fallback plan: can we route H100-bound requests to MI300 or Gaudi model variants by policy? If so, we can keep hosting live and avoid customer impact for the initial wave.

rob (hw-ops): Routing is feasible but batching/latency differs. Need product approval for changed SLAs during fallback. Also confirm model compatibility (quantization/profile) with MI300/Gaudi.

kevin (product): We can ship with a temporary note + reduced latency SLA for customers who opt in. Marketing needs copy.

elaine (partnerships): OK action items: 1) Rob repro + patched shim attempt (EOD). 2) Devon prepare routing playbook and policy JSON. 3) Sarah hold cutover if cert not green T-4h, notify infra. 4) Kevin draft announcement contingency.

devon (solutions): Putting together policy draft now. Sample fallback rule (will refine):

```
{
  "route_policy": "hardware_fallback",
  "priority": ["h100-optimized", "mi300-compat", "gaudi-compat"],
  "latency_note": "fallback_might_increase_p95 by ~30-80ms",
  "auto_revert_on": "h100_cert_ok"
}
```

rob (hw-ops): If shim works, we'll run a signed reimage and re-run certs. If not, we escalate with vendor for a signed GA image.

sarah (eng-platform): I'll gate the pipeline and put a hold note in the cutover runbook. If you tag me with #hold I'll stop automated promos.

kevin (product): I'll prep two short blurb options for marketing: 1) delayed availability with ETA, 2) available with fallback performance note.

elaine (partnerships): Great. Can everyone update the PRT-4921 ticket with status and ETA after lab attempt? I'll sync with vendor and legal on telemetry implications.

rob (hw-ops): Will update PRT-4921 by 3432104522 with logs and test steps.

devon (solutions): I'll post the full playbook in the repo and ping here when done.

elaine (partnerships): Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for embargo/announce decisions. :thumbsup:
